answer: We send the payoff to your lender within 2 business days, or the same day if the lender is in our e-payoff network. The help center doesn't say whether Pinewood Federal is in that network, so please contact a store to confirm. Since you're using home pickup, the $99 fee is taken out of your payment, and you receive whatever is left after the loan payoff. Keep making your loan payments until Pinewood confirms the payoff.
